result.description: Fictional mechanical drafting tablet designed for tabletop cartography, notation, and precision sketch workflows. The Quill Slate 96 uses an electrostatic drawing surface, onboard shortcut macros, and a low-noise haptic feedback layer for studio environments. It is positioned as a creative input device rather than a storage or graphics component, with emphasis on tactile control, desk ergonomics, and interchangeable nib profiles. Includes USB-C connectivity, adjustable pressure curves, and companion desktop calibration software.
result.title: LUMENFORGE Quill Slate 96
result.title_description: Precision creative input tablet for sketching and cartography
